title: Expository Visualization: Food Processing and Price
description: Designed an expository visualization using GroceryDB data to investigate how food processing relates to affordability. The analysis shows that ultra processed foods cost less per calorie but more by weight, challenging the common perception that processed foods are simply cheaper. The visualization uses median prices, normalized percentage differences, and NOVA processing classes to clearly communicate this contrast.

title: Airport Database Management System
description: Built a PostgreSQL airport database with role based access, Java query logic, and optimized indexing that improved performance by 40%.

title: F1 Driver Performance Prediction Model
description: Analyzed six F1 seasons using clustering and KNN regression to segment driver performance and predict outcomes with an R-squared of 0.63.

title: Imposter Syndrome Analysis
description: Analyzed student survey data in Python to explore relationships between imposter syndrome, coding confidence, and academic characteristics using statistical tests and interactive visualizations.

title: Hawaii Google Reviews Analysis
description: Explored how ratings, location, and restaurant characteristics relate to food prices across Hawaii using Google Maps data, interactive visualizations, hypothesis testing, and a random forest prediction model.

title: Movie Recommendation System
description: Built a personalized movie recommendation system in Python using item based collaborative filtering and cosine similarity to suggest movies based on users’ ratings and preferences.
